description: Defines the Polymer.IronValidatableBehavior, a behavior for validating user input in Polymer elements, including properties, methods, and validation logic.

methods.name: _invalidChanged
methods.description: Updates 'aria-invalid' attribute based on the 'invalid' property.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the given value and updates 'invalid' property.

methods.name: _getValidity
methods.description: Returns validity of the value, can be overridden for custom validation logic.
